intro.text: Hallandren's god of storms, one of the gods who play Tarachin every week with Lightsong, Truthcall and Lifeblesser.

items.text: Over Tarachin with Lightsong, Truthcall and Lifeblesser, he joins the talk of war with Idris and of using the new queen in the court's political games.
When the Court of Gods convenes to decide on war, Weatherlove turns up late.

appearance.text: Almost seven feet tall and powerfully built, with blond hair and clothing modelled on old paintings of earlier Returned. His colours are green and gold.

personality.text: Unpredictable, and fond of vague remarks meant to suggest he knows more than the other gods, though his scheming is nothing next to Blushweaver's. He seems to have designs of his own on Siri.
